en: A vintage colorized postcard view of a landscaped park with lawns, trees, and footpaths on a slope above a pond. In the pond is a small circular island with a modest house-like structure covered in vegetation. In the background, partly hidden by trees, are church spires and a large brick church building. The lower margin of the postcard contains printed text identifying the location and publisher, as well as handwritten greetings.
